visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman wearing a black cap, glasses, and a black face mask film a selfie-style video outdoors at night. She has wide eyes and an expressive look. High-contrast artificial street lighting illuminates her. (2) The scene shifts to a brightly lit shopping mall interior. A white Chanel bag is seen inside a larger denim tote bag. An older woman, dressed in a white and black cardigan, looks at the bag with a concerned expression. (3) The camera shows a shop front with the name 'Matto' on gold plaques. The interior features white shelves stocked with various luxury handbags. A tiled floor with a checkered pattern is visible. (4) Close-up shots of hands working on a white leather bag, showing the cleaning and restoration process. A hand applies a substance to the leather with a small cloth. (5) A person's hands hold a light-colored watch strap, demonstrating its stained and worn condition to the camera. (6) A calico cat with blue eyes walks across the checkered tiled floor of the shop. (7) A split-screen comparison shows the 'Before' and 'After' states of the white Chanel bag, highlighting the removal of blue denim stains. (8) The woman from the first phase stands in front of a mirror in a well-lit room, holding the restored white bag and smiling while filming with her phone.
